text: The loader shall perform no symbol resolution, nominal merging, relocation, constructor discovery, or factory execution as a loading expression. Off-device validation/install shall be permitted for small monitors when exact target state/segments remain the same. Host-only metadata shall not be charged as RAM; actual runtime tables shall be placed/charged.
